_about: The X-ray page (site/build.py build_xray, the page xray/index.html): its hero, the three steps and the gallery. Each entry is one verified X-ray film. Its video and poster are looked up as examples/_xray/<file> (in this checkout, the examples checkout, or a --media-from folder, by path or by release asset name, like every example video) and copied to media/xray/<file>; a missing video shows the poster, a missing poster a neutral card. The hero entry may name a "loop": a short silent cut it loops instead of the whole film. An entry with an empty receipt is shown as "in the works": no player and no commands, because nothing appears as finished without its `showtime xray verify` line. author is "showtime" for ours or a GitHub handle ("@name") for a community entry; mechanism names a folder of skills/showtime/library/xray/, linked when it exists. An entry may name "live", its live page (the file `showtime export html <project> --interactive` writes), looked up and copied like the video: a finished card then has a "Play it live" button that swaps its frame for the page, and an Embed snippet. "prompt" is one sentence, the request an agent would be given to make that film; it is shown, with a Copy button, above the commands.
_kinds: The kind filter: an entry's kind is one of these ids.
_layouts: How an entry's layout is named on its card.

entries.title: A typewriter, seen through
entries.what: Every keystroke swings its typebar up to the platen on the frame the clip's own sound says, drawn on the machine as the camera moves.
entries.receipt: 19 of 19 events on their frame · audio 0.0 ms from the original
entries.credit: Clip: Erik Pålsson / Sounds of Changes
entries.author: showtime
commands: showtime xray analyze clip.mp4 --job xray-typewriter --track --region "x,y x,y x,y x,y" --ref-time 1.0
showtime new xray xray-typewriter/project --mechanism typewriter --layout through --theme dark
entries.prompt: /showtime x-ray this clip of my typewriter, drawn on the machine.

_touch: Living diagrams people touch (no clip): each a live figure from `showtime export html <project> --interactive`, found as examples/_xray/<figure> like the films; poster optional; verb is the button's words; prompt and commands as for the films.

touch.title: Type on a typewriter
touch.what: Type on your keyboard and the machine types it: the key goes down, its typebar swings up and strikes, the letter lands on the paper, the carriage steps, the bell rings near the margin, and Enter returns the carriage.
touch.prompt: /showtime explain how a typewriter works inside, interactive: let me type on it.
commands: showtime new diagram typewriter --example typewriter --theme dark

touch.title: What happens when you press a key
touch.what: Type on your keyboard: the key goes down, its USB code waits for the next poll, the CPU takes the interrupt, and the screen draws it at its next refresh. Slowed down about 30 times; typical numbers, labelled.
touch.prompt: /showtime explain what happens when you press a key, interactive.

touch.title: A heat pump: drag the weather
touch.what: Drag the outdoor unit to make it colder or milder outside: the refrigerant and the heat moved per unit of power answer at once (illustrative numbers, from one formula).
touch.prompt: /showtime explain how a heat pump works, interactive: let me drag the weather.
